notes: Identity independently checked: supplied text identifies Eugene M. Caruso, When the Future Feels Worse Than the Past: A Temporal Inconsistency in Moral Judgment, Journal of Experimental Psychology: General (2010), 139(4), 610–624, DOI 10.1037/a0020757. It is a primary journal article text with methods, results and references, not an abstract or secondary report. No PDF supplied. Study 1 is explicitly Experiment 1: Coke Vending Machine; temporal location predicts fairness judgments. Printed β retained without conversion to requested d; standardisation is not assumed. The total temporal-location effect on fairness is distinguished from the negative-emotion effect (β = 0.18), adjusted temporal-location effect (β = −0.13), and Coke-motives outcome.
